title: Ashyan bar Nidbakh or Nidbah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He was Rav Yeiva’s son-in-law, as in Bava Batra 22b, and reported Rav Yehudah, as in Menachot 29a. The Rif and Rosh, in the laws of Torah scrolls and mezuzah, read that he reported Rav, as does Dikdukei Soferim on Menachot there. In Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 1:9, folio 11a, Rabbi Zeira reports him; there the patronym is bar Nidbah.

notes.text: The ending says the name there is bar Nidbah, not that Zeira reports a second sage of that name. The complete Megillah 1:9 paragraph places the relevant teaching in the 11a section.
